newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ex-Soviet republics in step closer to Euro-Council.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Soviet republics in step closer to Euro-Council.

text.p: Former Soviet republics Armenia, Azerbaijan and Georgia will sign on April 25 the Council of Europe's cultural convention, the Council said on Thursday.
The Council, which safeguards human rights and democracy in its 40 member states, said in a statement this "represents a first step towards membership of the Council of Europe".
Forty-four countries have already signed the convention, which covers cooperation on culture, education, teaching, sport and youth issues.
Armenia, Georgia and Azerbaijan have benefited from special guest status at the Council since last year.
